output.summary: A vigorous evergreen climber native to the North African coast and its coastal mountains, including those of Algeria, it clings by aerial roots and has reddish stems. Its fertile branches usually have less-lobed leaves than its younger stems. Eating the leaves or berries can cause severe discomfort and mild poisoning.
output.edibilityNote: The leaves and berries contain hederagenin; ingesting them may cause severe discomfort and mild poisoning.
